scope: Behavior, ARIA, filtering, parts, events and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup and composed parts. Rendered lengths are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: anatomy, combobox / listbox ARIA, no native form elements, filtering (contains, accents folded), arrows over visible enabled options, autoHighlight, Enter / press commit, Escape restores the label, trigger, clear, multiple chips (toggle, remove, Backspace), form value, required, disabled, composition, events with Base UI reasons
resolveCombobox: the row, input edges, 6u clear and trigger slots, chips, wrap lines, popup and empty state
React SSR: the same data-* and recipe classes as the web component on host, input, trigger, clear, popup, list and items; the composed parts render the preset

limitations: Popup placement comes from layout; happy-dom reports zero boxes, so the browser geometry check and the cross-browser check cover it.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio at u = 2, 3, the theme unit 4.5, 4 and 6, B = 0 and 1, light and dark): growth (a long selected label scrolls inside the input and never pushes the clear and trigger slots; more chips than fit wrap the row onto lines 0.5u apart, 8u + 6.5u a line, with clear and trigger held on the first line; slots and chips keep 6u at u = 2), RTL (dir=rtl mirrors the row: leading on the right, chips flow right to left with their remove button at the inline end, clear and trigger on the left; the popup aligns to the row's start), focus (the 2px ring sits outside the row on :focus-within, so it never changes the row's size; clear, trigger and chip-remove are not tab stops), screenshots of the Selection family and an open, filtered, empty and multiple popup checked light and dark.
